$comment: Shared, versioned Claude Code config for movienight. The Stop hook runs
the same suite CI runs, so a turn cannot end red locally and then fail in
CI. Logic lives once in a shared test-gate.sh (symlinked into
~/.claude/scripts/); the command it runs is .claude/test-command. On a
machine without that script the hook is a no-op.
Session-specific permissions belong in the gitignored settings.local.json.
